text: This report provides a review and recommendation regarding the investment consultant (Aon) for the Toronto Investment Board. The current contract with Aon is for three years with an option to extend for another two years. The current contract was awarded by the Board at its meeting on December 16, 2022 with Aon to provide services from 2023 to 2026, with the option to extend the contract for another two years. City staff recommend to extend this contract for another two years based on the Evaluation Scorecard found in Confidential Attachment 1 of this report.
The Toronto Investment Board: 1. Deferred consideration of this item until the next special meeting called by the Chair.
